reviews.text: Everyone was so welcoming here and made me and my pet feel less nervous! Dr. Fusco is very knowledgable and helped me understand everything very clearly. Totally recommend bringing your pets!
Great service! Dr.Fusco treated my dog as she was his own! 10/10 would recommend

Dr. Fusco is absolutely amazing! I couldn’t be happier with the care and compassion my dog has received. Dr. Fusco is incredibly knowledgeable, patient, and truly takes the time to explain everything and answer any questions. You can tell that he genuinely cares about his patients and treats every animal as if they were her own.
The entire experience has always been wonderful, and I feel completely confident knowing my pet is in such caring and capable hands. Finding a veterinarian you can truly trust is so important, and I’m incredibly grateful to have found Dr. Fusco. I highly recommend him to anyone looking for an exceptional veterinarian! 🐾❤️

I’m really shocked by my experience with associate vet Lexy So- if you can’t see Dr. Fusco, you should not work with her. She was extremely unprofessional and failed to help treat my dog for a simple bacterial infection. She spoke to me like I was stupid, and couldn't make eye-contact or complete the diagnosis or prescription. I was baffled by her unprofessionalism, and she ended up walking out and refusing to help my dog. This was our second visit after the first anti-biotic prescription course was insufficient. I'm not sure why Dr. Fusco hired this chick. She's super awful.

My experience with Adams Veterinary Clinic and Dr. Allen Fusco, DVM, was unacceptable. I perceived an absolute lack of empathy, respect for my cat and professional responsibility. I left with the impression that charging was more important than ensuring their care.

I took my four-year-old cat to Romeo for a urinary obstruction at 4:05 p.m. I asked what procedure I needed and what the approximate cost would be. Dr. Fusco gave me $1,500. I accepted, hoping for honesty, proper attention and a clear explanation of the risks.
I specifically asked if Rome would have overnight supervision. The doctor replied that if he wanted surveillance all night, he should take it to the emergency room and that this would cost me money. I perceived his tone as mocking and dismissive. As I recall, he told me to leave him there and come back the next day to see his progress. I did not receive a sufficient explanation about the risks of leaving him unsupervised or the necessary guidance to make an informed decision.

During the night, Rome did not bite and break the catheter. According to what I was informed, there was no one present to intervene when it happened. He now has a piece of fragment stuck inside and is in another clinic, in emergencies, being evaluated by a surgeon to determine how to remove it and if he needs surgery.

As Dr. Lexy So, VMD, explained to me, Rome should have been sent to the emergency room from the beginning because of the severity of the obstruction and because it required constant observation. He also pointed out problems with catheter placement.

I am deeply outraged. I felt that charging the $1,500 was more important than explaining how they would protect Rome overnight. The lack of empathy, communication and human quality that I perceived was enormous. I relied on this clinic to take care of my sick cat and ended up facing an even more serious and absolutely distressing situation.

I believe that the attention we received was far from the ethics and responsibility I expect from a veterinary professional. A sick animal deserves care and respect. His family deserves clear information about the risks, the supervision available and the need to transfer him to the emergency room.
From my experience, I do not recommend the Adams Veterinary Clinic or Dr. Allen Fusco. I would never trust my pets again. My recommendation is that they look for another option.

To those considering leaving their pet there: be very careful. Ask if there will be staff present during the night, what surveillance your animal will receive and how they will respond to a complication. Do not assume that "hospitalization" means supervision. I trusted, and today Rome is suffering the consequences of a complication that occurred while I was under the care of this clinic.
IF YOU CARE ABOUT YOUR LOVE ONES PLEASE, PLEASE LOOK OTHER WAY NOT AT THIS HORRIBLE PLACE
Prompt friendly and the price was fair

I’d give 6 starts to everyone in this clinic, from the front desk to the vet. You guys were amazing! Got my 3 pets there (1 dog and 2 cats), quickly the vet and her assistant took care of them. Never seen my pets behaving so well. The ladies at the front desk were really helpful since my first phone call, getting Health Certificates done and we were good to go in minutes. They really took good care of us, lovely people ❤️ I wish I knew you guys before, now that we’re moving out 🥲 Best price as well, I quoted with at least 3 different clinics. Thank you guys 🙏🏼

Happen Dr Lex, she is applied Revolt in my cat  without ask, just to charge 35.00 and the famous waste fee? This never happen in the past also she had a bad attitude. Things change Adam's Clinic isn't the same anymore.
The team is always attentive to Greta's needs. I appreciate how they care for our dogs. Service level is great!
Best vet in miami shores!

I got my health certificate to leave the United States and everything went perfectly. The receptionists are very nice, and the doctors are too. I've been choosing them since I adopted a kitten almost a year ago, and they've always been great to me.

Dr. Fusco was very professional, very down-to-earth, gave me clear instructions and treated my pet with care and attention. I was highly satisfied with the services at Adams Veterinary Clinic and will gladly bring in my other pets as needed.

***** Highly recommend them,,
Treated  my Yorkie eyes with care and compassion ,,
Much appreciated that DR. Fusco gave my babe ,,
No hassles , got the appointment the same day ,,, very reasonable with the charges ,,,

DO NOT GO TO THIS VET. The vet, Lexy so, suggested putting my dog down. I decided to get a second opinion so I went to a new clinic and the vet (who clearly loves his job) said that putting her down was NOT an option whatsoever. I called to get the results of some test that were ran on my dog but they never sent it therefore the receptionist at the new vet called and they refused to send it. I called about 10 more times because I was there for 45 minutes without a single email… and they would purposely pick up the phone just to hang it up. Not to mention that the vet LEXY SO had the worst attitude ever as she is looking me in the eye telling me to put my dog down…. like mama you need to specialize in a new profession because you clearly hate your life. WILL NEVER EVER EVER BE BACK not even if this was the last vet on Earth.
Fair prices , the doctors there are super knowledgeable and they have great customer service at the front. I love that they have great availability
This place is great. No hidden fees. Straight to the point. Walks in only.  Friendly and accommodating.  Prices are fair.
Super professional and exhaustive

The doctor and the admin staff were so wonderful so attentive and got me in immediately. My cat had gotten into a street fight and they got him in immediately so I was very appreciative and they did a great job.. 🫶 this will be my new clinic going forward. …
Reliable and professional
We have only been here twice. Both times we experienced a small veterinary clinic vibe with decent prices. They really seem to care. We plan to go back if we need care for our fur babies.
Doctors who really care along with a great staff...
I will never take my animals to this vet again, they denied their medicine because I switched vets

I brought my cat into this vet for an injury she sustained. The doctor was very thorough, kind & informative. They had me in & out quickly and answered all my questions. The rest of the staff were also helpful and professional. Lastly, the pricing was very fair, compared other vets I’ve visited. I would recommend this vet office to anyone I know!

Dr. Lexy was amazing! The front desk staff was polite and actually acknowledging my cat. Having come out of a really bad experience from another clinic, I was relieved to be able to deal with professionals with compassion, expertise, and reassurance. Dr. Lexy was able to sort out what could actually be going on with my cat and we are starting from the bottom through a process of elimination that I can actually afford. Last place was trying to run me up for over thousands of dollars in tests..where here I left paying under $200. I feel reassured and satisfied we are on a good path to help my cat get better. This experience was night and day from this other place and I am so grateful <3
Always friendly staff and patient.  My vito loves them too❤️

I have been coming here for 5+ years and up until today, I’ve been so happy with Dr. Allen and this practice. This morning, I arrived at 8am to drop my dog off for a dental cleaning. No one was there. I was standing in the door and a woman arrived behind me. I turned to tell her no one was there and she replied such an attitude that “I’M TRYING TO UNLOCK THE DOOR” … I said, you don’t need to be rude about it. She then proceeded to continue being nasty and say “I’M RUDE? HAHA .. I’M THE DOCTOR AND I’M THE ONLY DOCTOR..” I get inside to find out that she is the one doing the cleaning on my dog… I am not comfortable now leaving my dog in the hands of this angry woman (Dr. Lexy So) … The front desk woman tried to calm the situation by talking to her and I CAN HEAR Dr. Lexy So in the back TALKING LOUDLY ABOUT ME and saying “I don’t want to talk to her!” …. NEVER in my life have I been treated this way in a business. Now I’ve paid for bloodwork to be done to have this appointment and I didn’t follow through with the cleaning because HOW ON EARTH am I supposed to leave my little dog with this woman that clearly has anger issues. SHE WAS CLEARLY LATE FOR WORK AND TOOK IT OUT ON ME. I’m sadly shopping for a new vet.
Dr Lexi is wonderful and very knowledgeable. The rest of the staff is very helpful as well.
I love the staff. The ones I’ve known for years. Remember me every time I go in and the ones I just recently met. Treat you like they’ve known you for years.
Super friendly

I almost never leave reviews, but my experience with the morning shift staff was truly disappointing. They were rude, unprofessional, and refused to provide the information I needed. They hung up on me several times and kept me on hold as soon as they recognized my voice. It’s a shame that because of their terrible customer service, the excellent veterinarians at this clinic end up looking bad.

If you don’t like your job, change it. Clients shouldn’t have to deal with that kind of disrespect. When I mentioned that I have two cats I wanted to vaccinate with them, the response I got was: “I don’t care.” Completely unacceptable for a place that should care about people and their pets.

Remember, you’re in the United States — treat everyone with professionalism and respect.
Best vet in town he really cared about my cat Cici. Also explained in detail what was the best actions to take for her. The staff was friendly and very helpful best place to go.
Simply the best vet practice available. Welcome to Dr So who joins a wonderful team. If you have a pet that you care about, use Adams for their care!
Their staff are caring and professional. I have been going here for years and they have always been consistent at being amazing with pets.
Hope is feeling so much better, thanks too you and the staff. Over and beyond for PTSD services dog and me disabled veteran.

The best Clinic I very experienced with my pet . The Doctor there really cares about your pet and find the best solution in helping your pet get well again. I highly recommend this clinic to everyone and anyone. The staff is so helpful just like the doctor. Out of all the animals clinics I been through this is the first I really love for my pet. The price is affordable, staff is great and they have so many programs you can enroll to make sure your pet get the best care and attention they deserve.
Great experience ♥️🫶🏻 …
Very caring and welcoming staff. This was my first time here, and I will definitely be coming back.

I have been going to Adam’s veterinary clinic for 42 years,  Dr. Fusco, is amazing. I had the pleasure of meeting Dr.Lexy So today, She was very nice, She took the time to speak with me for us to get acquainted The staff that are there are amazing as well,  Everyone at Adam veterinary clinic are professional and courteous and friendly. It feels like one big family. They have taken care of my boy Shiloh for 15 years
I've been going to Adams Clinic for over thirty years with my various fur babies and am very pleased with the care and compassion shown to them.

We had a great experience with our puppy Zoey. The vet gave us lots of information and answered all of our questions. We did not wait long and were easily able to get an appointment. Everyone was very friendly and helpful. We will be back in 3 weeks for the next round of shots! Thank you!
I like this clinic; you don't need to make appointments. Walk-ins are okay. Dr. is nice, as well as the staff.
The sweetest staff, Doctor Fusco and Doctor So are the most caring people
Best veterinarians in the area.  (I’ve had bad experiences with some others.)
We have been going to Adams for years and trust them with our furry family member. Dr. Fusco, Dr. So, Jennifer and team are all wonderful and caring humans. Thank you!

I had to bring my clients cat to the vet on a Saturday, Adams was open and available and got me in within 10 minutes!! They were knowledgeable, kind, and so efficient. They had me in a room within 3 mins, and out within 20. I’ve been pet sitting for a decade and this was the best vet experience I’ve ever had!! Considering making them my vet for my pet :)

Best veterinary clinic I’ve ever been to. Such kind and helpful staff, making every step of the way easy. It’s hard to find an honest and good veterinarian these days but these guys really are the gold in the pot 🥰 …
Everyone was very pleasant, helpful and professional. I felt very welcome. Everything was explained clearly.

Telephoned on a Tuesday morning as my dog cut his paw very badly & they saw him immediately.

I had to leave him for a full anaesthetic, stitches & bandaging.

I picked him & his medicine up with the instructions to preferably crate him for 10-14 days, but as I am from the UK visiting my son, this was impossible

However, now, on day 6 he is having short lead walks 3-4 times a day.  He can not go into the garden alone as he is a high-energy working dog breed who loves to chase the lizards & squirrels & will jump up trees after them.

He is back to Adams on Friday to hopefully have the stitches removed.

So far, Adams has been great.
The staff is extremely friendly.  The office is a family atmosphere.  We moved across the county but I still use them as our vet.

Dr Allen Fusco is beyond amazing and always great to help you with any pet needs and questions you may have. Today we got to meet Dr So. She was very nice too, taking her time to get my anxious girl Rue calm before she proceeded to do her annual check-up. The assistants were amazing too, keeping her calm and steady throughout the checkup. She even got a pedicure (her nails cut) and it all went super easy and fast. We are so grateful for the amazing care and wonderful team here, from the check-in through the checkout, everyone was amazing and everything went super smooth. I highly recommend this place for your precious little ones needs ❤️🥰
I've been taking my pets to Adams Veterinary Clinic for about 30 years and will continue to do so.
Best place best price wonderful caring people love the doctor definitely a plus
A team of caring individuals that understand how important my animals are to me.
Very friendly and helpful staff.

I have been going to this clinic for some time because it is conveniently located near my home. The care is okay, but you always need to be vigilant about the charges and recommendations they give you—some of them seem unnecessary.

However, my worst experience happened five months ago when my older dog was unwell. I arrived at the clinic 20 minutes before closing, struggling to get inside with a stroller. The staff saw me entering, watched as I carried my dog up the steps, and only after I was inside did they tell me the doctor’s office was already closed. This was despite still having 20 minutes before their official closing time.

Unfortunately, my dog passed away the next day. I’m not saying they are unsafe, but they could have shown a little more compassion. If you truly care about your pet, I would recommend finding a clinic where the staff genuinely cares about the animals they treat.
Congratulations on the great work you do, the kindness and love with which you treat the pets, thank you
Very attentive, polite and punctual. Thank you

Tried finding someone urgently as my dog took ill suddenly over long weekend . They were very accommodating under such short notice even though i wasn’t an existing client and their office was quite busy. The front desk was extremely helpful and an absolute pleasure to deal with and since I was already dealing with stress about my dog’s health, this was a welcome relief. The Doctor and the assistant was just as pleasant and knowledgeable. I would highly recommend them. I think I just found my new Vet as I have been looking for one since the lovely Dr Fleck passed away.

Dr Lexy So is AMAZING! Super friendly, thorough and easy going, treats my chihuahuas as if they where hers.

Love this Vet clinic, it's super easy to make appointments, fast replies by email and phone and excellent service by a very, very friendly and knowledgeable staff.

I took my dog here for the first time today after the vet I typically go to handed me a lengthy, page-long, itemized $1900 bill with zero alternative options for my dog to go under and get surgery to have an abscess removed.

I looked up the closest vet and came in for a walk-in after seeing positive reviews.

They were incredibly welcoming! The doctor and nurse took the time to explain everything to me about what could possibly be happening with my dog.

They shaved the large area where his abscess was, lanced / drained it, gave me antibiotics, provided me with a cone, and sent a blood sample to a lab for $370.

My decision to come here for a second opinion saved me $1500 today.

I will now be coming here for all of my dog’s needs.

They are no-nonsense, communicative, and caring! Please be careful in Miami about predatory penny-pinching veterinary clinics who take advantage of our love for our pets.

Thanking the universe for places like this and people like these professionals. My pup was hit by a car this morning. SCARY! Our usual vet doesn’t open until 10am and they are about 30 out from where we live. We needed something close and open and this office came up on our goggle search, close by and opens at 8am. Hubby rushed our dog over. By the time I got there, about 30 minutes later, he had already been seen, and a plan was in place for treatment. Everyone was welcoming, attentive, dr was readily available to give me an update. Office is IMPECCABLY CLEAN, calm vibe. They took VERY good care of our fur baby. I think…. No, I KNOW we have found a new vet. Our dog was very lucky no damage was done, thank goodness. I am very happy with the service and will be back, hopefully not for an emergency.
Love this place! The team is always helpful and professional. Great service!
I have been coming to Adams for many years.  The staff is always professional and helpful.  The Doctors always explain what and why they’re doing something.
Dr. So is the best. Super through, friendly, and helpful with all my questions.
Short wait timw. Friendly staff and vet.
Amazing team. Happy we find them

Right away they let my dog in! the receptionist was amazing and extremely helpful and the vet and nurses where awesome as well and they took care of him right away! Thank you! I high recommend this place if you have emergency or anything! First time there and transferring my dog to this vet!

Omg! Let's start with the cleanliness of this office... super clean! I went for the first time to this vet and it was only for paperwork regarding international travel. The customer service was so amazing and the vet, Dr. So, is Heaven sent! So much so that this clinic will now be my fur baby's new home! Not only was the service amazing, I also received a personalized and detailed email from Dr. So listing all things discussed about my fur baby during our visit, to include recommendations for the future. I had an amazing experience and absolutely recommend🩷
What a fantastic experience. First time with the clinic and everyone from the front office to the team in the back were amazing. Looking forward to seeing them again soon!

One of our cats, Onyx, was suffering from an injection site sarcoma. This was caused by the carelessness of another Miami Beach veterinary clinic a few years ago.
We first brought Onyx in back in March, where he was correctly diagnosed. The condition is terminal.
On Oct. 17, we brought Onyx in for euthanasia. The professionalism and empathy shown by the staff was exemplary; Onyx passed peacefully.
Any pets that we get in the future are coming to Adams for their care. We wouldn't trust them with anyone else.
Please take your animals there, you will get best care.
If you have a cherished pet, Adams is a caring and reasonable team. No heroics, just the best care that is available and affordable

Dr. Valderrama has been nothing but the best when providing care to our family pets.  It's bitter sweet to see her moving onto bigger things but we will continue to let Adam's be our primary clinic for the time being.
Fun and friendly place to take your fur children for excellent care

Amazing clinic! They are always readily available to serve my cats the care and help that they need. I always do walk in appointments with no issue, and always am greeted with smiles and no judgement. :)
Very professional staff and Dr. Fusco is incredible. Made me feel at ease through all treatment. This is the best vet clinic in Miami hands down!
The Doctor and the staff were very professional, compassionate and helpful, highly recommended!!!
